headline: Sri Lanka Central Bank Hikes Key Policy Rate by 25 Bps on Inflation Risks
summary: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka unexpectedly raised its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points on Friday, citing imported inflation pressures driven by volatile global energy prices.
why: Sri Lanka continues to navigate external debt and balance-of-payments stabilisation following its comprehensive economic restructuring program.
